github.comment: Instructions: Generate a personal access token (classic or fine-grained) in GitHub Developer Settings with repo read/write scopes, and paste it here.

context7.comment: Instructions: Context7 provides up-to-date documentation. Works without an API key, but you can get a free key from context7.com for higher rate limits.

filesystem.comment: Instructions: Provides tools to read, write, and list files. Add any other local directories to the args array if needed.

playwright.comment: Instructions: Used for browser automation and web scraping. Requires Playwright browsers installed.

supabase.comment: Instructions: Allows database and doc interactions. Alternatively, use the remote connection: { "type": "http", "url": "https://mcp.supabase.com/mcp" } and log in through the browser.
